name: Zeta Internet
summary: One of Australia's earliest ISPs (Zeta Microcomputer Software, later Kralizec Pty Ltd); family-owned by Nick and Masami Andrew; Riverstone POP (02 9837 exchange) for western-Sydney local calls; acquired by Pacific Internet Dec 1999.

events.details: First commercial Internet access (9600bps, 3 dial-in lines); BBS from 1985; domain zeta.org.au 1991.
Acquired by Pacific Internet (with Hub Communications, ~7,000 subscribers).
